common: Create one premium minimalist technical pictogram for a German engineering e-learning slide. Genuine transparent background, square canvas, centered single motif, bold compact silhouette, flat 2D, front or orthographic view. Marine navy #142452 is the dominant color and use only the requested semantic accent. No text, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no background plate, no border, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no 3D, no isometric perspective, no photorealism, no emoji or sticker style. Keep at least 8 percent transparent margin and make the motif immediately recognizable at 48 pixels.

assets.prompt: Show direct-current electrical energy entering from left to right: two clean parallel conductors with a small solid rightward energy arrow and an unmistakable DC symbol made only from a solid line above a broken line, without letters. Avoid batteries and sine waves.

Show a simplified human index finger firmly pressing a large industrial emergency-stop pushbutton, with one small lightning-bolt energy cue beside the press point. The press action must be obvious. Avoid touchscreens, tools and warning triangles.

Show a compact technical transmitter or control module sending three clean directed radio-wave arcs toward the upper right. Include a small connector base so it reads as a technical signal source rather than a generic Wi-Fi logo.
Show a compact mechanical component viewed from the front with two bold opposing vibration arrows and short motion lines on both sides. It must read as mechanical vibration, not radio or sound.
Show several distinct dust and dirt particles striking a clean technical ventilation surface or filter grille. Keep the particles chunky and separated. Avoid smoke, fire, explosions and clouds.
Show a bold vertical thermometer beside exactly three upward heat-wave strokes. It must mean ambient heat, not fire or combustion.
Show one large water droplet with two smaller humidity droplets or particles beside it and a subtle technical surface line below. It must mean moisture or humidity, not a broken pipe or rain scene.

Show electrical energy leaving a compact converter module toward the right as one bold clean sine wave terminating in a small rightward arrow. It must read as alternating-current output, not a chart or direct current.
